description.fun: A robot Cobalion with drill-like horns that grow long, bright-blue particle blades able to slice through any material. A paranormal magazine described it as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like Cobalion, and there was supposedly an incident where it cut everything around it to pieces. Its name plays on 'crown' as both the top of the head and a ruler.
description.guide: A Steel and Psychic-type Paradox Pokémon introduced in The Indigo Disk, said to be either a future relative of Cobalion or a version of it from a parallel timeline. The glowing parts of its horns form energy blades. Its counterpart is Raging Bolt.
description.tagline: A robot Cobalion whose horns sprout blades that cut anything
